title: Session kinds and endings, one Record toggle, and Close, Finish and Leave

tasks.title: The room ends for everyone, starts again for its owner, and ends after the owner is gone 2 minutes
Record on and off with pause and resume on one clock
Close, Finish, End and Leave, the closed notice, and the kind chosen at Start

acs.text: WHILE the room's owner leads a session THE SYSTEM SHALL show one Record control in the room window; pressing it starts recording the room, pressing it again pauses, and again resumes, any number of times; every paused stretch is cut, so the recording's media and its reader timeline share one clock whose length is the sum of the recorded stretches

WHEN the owner presses Close room and confirms THE SYSTEM SHALL end the session for everyone: a recording in progress is finished and saved, the owner's call is left, and every participant is taken out of the room's context and told "The room was closed." with a link to the room's page
scenarios: AC-002 the owner closes the room

acs.text: WHEN a participant who is not the owner presses Leave in the room window THE SYSTEM SHALL take only them out of the room and its call; the session goes on for everyone else

WHEN the owner of a closed room enters it again THE SYSTEM SHALL start a new session in it; while the relay still holds the closed session, a member who enters before the owner is told the room was closed
scenarios: AC-004 a closed room starts again

acs.text: WHEN the room's owner has been gone from a live session for 2 minutes THE SYSTEM SHALL end it as AC-002 says; the owner coming back within the 2 minutes keeps it going
scenarios: AC-005 the owner is gone for 2 minutes

acs.text: WHEN a person starts a room THE SYSTEM SHALL let them choose what it is — a room (people can join and talk), a broadcast (people watch), or just me (a recording) — and whether to record it (off for a room, on for a broadcast and for just me); the session starts that way
scenarios: AC-006 choosing the kind at Start

acs.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL label the owner's ending by the session's kind: Finish and save (just me), End broadcast (broadcast), Close room (room); a participant's is Leave
